title: Map popups are back
changes: Location details open over the map while the sidebar stays available for browsing.
Closing a popup returns to the full map view. Selected pins stay visible beside the popup.
A crosshairs icon makes the location finder easier to recognize.
Updates is now a changelog for site improvements and fixes.

title: Charging ratings at a glance
changes: Prominent color-coded rating badges appear beside charging location names.
Ratings are visible in search results, map details, saved places, and location pages.
Charging details use simpler labels and show when their information was captured.

title: A new way to explore
changes: Separate Charging and Rivian Places views, with six location categories and distinct map symbols.
Charging details include pricing, connector types, charging speeds, and individual port information where available.
Daily data refreshes keep the directory current, with dated charger issue reports on location pages.
Restored all three Outpost map pins and added a Full Overview control.
